publishedfiledetails.title: 大背包BigBackpack3.0(自用)
publishedfiledetails.file_description:
大背包是基于大背包模组修改，原作者为Roomcar，感谢群友:画师@大阿菲 画了背景边框贴图
猫趴和萝卜冰箱是提取修改了虚空异界（泰拉）模组里面的，可以在模组配置中设置是否启用
[b]默认都是在炼金引擎才能解锁制作[/b]
[h3][b]大背包：[/b][/h3]
固定5*10的格子，可以一键整理，可配置移速，防水和保鲜效果，在容器栏制作
[h3][b]猫趴：[/b][/h3]
修改较多，不喜欢用的可以在模组配置中关闭它
护甲栏制作，一个带4格返鲜格子的永久光源（偶尔照明失效重新穿戴即可），可以作祟复活，拥有沙漠护目镜效果
第一格放入小鱼块——恢复精神值，放得越多回得越快，每次放入小鱼块需要全部拿起来重新放一下才能更新恢复速度
第二格放入雨具——继承防水值，只要带防水效果的东西都可以继承(模组物品不一定支持)
第三格放入护具——继承防御值（无法继承位面防御值），耐久消耗降低20%
第四格放入改变移速的物品——继承移速值(可以是减速，模组物品不一定支持)，放入蓝宝石——可以隔热，放入红宝石——可以保暖
不再支持通过喂食改变里面物品的耐久了，不再会消耗小鱼块恢复自身耐久
可同步显示第三格中护甲的耐久度，放入新护甲或重新穿戴后可更新耐久度显示
[spoiler]增加了20位面防御和20%暗影和月亮阵营减伤，穿戴时可以增加亮茄剑，亮茄法杖，暗夜剑，暗影收割者的一点物理伤害和较多的位面伤害[/spoiler]
[h3][b]胡萝卜冰箱：[/b][/h3]
烹饪栏制作，16格容器10倍反鲜，但不可以放暖石
[h3][b]和虚空异界(泰拉)模组一起使用，可能会出问题[/b][/h3]
感谢各位模组的作者和画师，大家多多支持原版
本模组仅为方便自己和好友使用上传，仅为自用修改！！！
如有侵权，联系我修改或者删除！！！

publishedfiledetails.title: Backpack Slot
publishedfiledetails.file_description:
Detach the backpack from body slot! Amulet slots can be enabled in the configuration

publishedfiledetails.title: Open Backpacks on Ground
publishedfiledetails.file_description:
Right-click a backpack on the ground to open its inventory UI, with drag-and-drop support using the right mouse button.

Compatible with Backpack, Piggyback, Krampus Sack, Insulated Pack, Seed Pack-It, Candy Bag, and Chef Pouch.

----------------------------------------------Attention--------------------------------------------
This mod may conflict with other mods that modify backpack interaction behaviors!

publishedfiledetails.title: Backpack Decorator
publishedfiledetails.file_description:
A mod that adds an icon to fill in the empty space left by the krampus sack with integrated backpack layout. 

The image can be changed by left clicking it and selecting a new one from the menu.
If you are for some reason unable to change the image by clicking it, you can use the console command "SelectNewFiller()" to force the selection menu open.
Some images will have a special functionality with right click.

[h1]Bugs[/h1]
- Using a console command to change the decorator while not in a world will cause a crash. Please open a world first.

[h1]Plans[/h1]
- More images, many more images.
- Option to fill more missing inventory slots for smaller backpack sizes.

Fixed the bug where an attempt was made to counterattack Moonfire

25.11.22 V1.2
Added the backpack's abilities to restore SAN, keep warm, be rainproof, counterattack, be non-rotting, and have infinite stacking.
In the default settings, the seed bag is the strongest tier.

allow players to craft Krampus Sack (Need Stag Antler)
